importDecision.reason: The page needs strict mixed-frequency series, publication-status unions, component-level derivations, context evidence hashes and a fail-closed fingerprint linking the display snapshot to the score artifact. These source tables are not already published in the integrated corpus.

money.rule: Most series are indices, rates or ratios. The only monetary input is general-government debt stock in MIO_EUR, used exclusively with same-year population to derive euros per inhabitant; it is never summed with payments, commitments or forecasts.

period.rule: Every point carries reference period, period start, frequency and publication status; missing observations are omitted and never interpolated.

provenance.rule: Every source records holder, query and landing URLs, reuse terms, upstream update, acquisition timestamp, byte size and SHA-256. Validation occurs during the recorded acquisition.

formats: AMECO CSV ZIP via the registered core artifact
sourceContract.hashRule: SHA-256 is calculated from every acquired response and stored in the generated snapshot; derived points preserve component hashes.
sourceContract.schemaRule: Dataset code, dimensions, filters, countries, periods, numeric values and publication flags are validated fail-closed.

license.eurostat: Free reuse with source acknowledgement, subject to the exceptions in the Eurostat copyright notice

period.latestRule: latest published period available independently for each display series, preserving observed, provisional and estimated status
period.missingRule: omit unavailable source observations; never interpolate

sources.role: quarterly primary balance derived from net lending plus interest payable

contextRule: A single geopolitics, shocks and crises category contains only essential source-backed events with a documented economic channel; an empty category is allowed only after the verified catalog has been checked.
